content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Sugar Land

steps_items.heading: Verify Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires a secondary diploma (or equivalent) and completion of project management education hours—but no work experience. If you hold a high school diploma or associate degree, you're eligible to pursue this credential without prior PM background.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Hours of PM Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot camp. This intensive format compresses CAPM fundamentals into a focused schedule, fitting around your Sugar Land-area job or commitments while meeting PMI's contact-hour requirement.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing education, apply directly to PMI and pay the exam fee. Granite PM Academy will guide you through the application process to ensure your eligibility is confirmed before you sit for the exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the CAPM Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation materials and support to build confidence. You'll test your knowledge of project management processes, terminology, and best practices before scheduling your official PMI exam.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your CAPM Credential
steps_items.text: CAPM credentials renew on a three-year cycle. Earn professional development units (PDUs) through training, conference attendance, or volunteer project work to keep your credential active and strengthen your profile in your local job market.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.
